### ① Derived judgments

Reading time 2026-10-17T23:40Z. Inputs read: card #12733 body and all 5 comments (unlock `6239084466`, claim `6241934953`, the withdrawn rival claim `6242014192` / `6242057382`, os-dev-report `6243019442`); PR #12926 body, its 22-file list, the net diff against `main` at the head; the 35 check-runs on `3aacb6e1c`; the cited code on both clones' `origin/main`. The PR's file list is the brief's 21 scope paths plus the one `.changeset/**` file, nothing else.

**Check-runs on the head (35 = total_count).** success: Repo Gates, Build & E2E, Bundle Analysis, Build Docs, Lint, Line Citation Gate, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Changeset Declaration, Changeset Bump Policy, Changeset Fixed Group Check, Changeset Claim Re-read, Changeset Overwrite Report, Test (dist pins), Test shards 3, 5, 7, 8, 11, 13, 14 of 16, Live E2E (informational), label. skipped: Test (coverage), Test (coverage shard), dependabot. **in_progress at reading time, reported as such and not as passed: Type Check, and Test shards 1, 2, 4, 6, 9, 10, 12, 15, 16 of 16.** No check-run has failed. Nothing read below predicts a red among the running ones; a red there is the queue guard's to stop, not this record's to foresee.

**A. What leaves `@object-ui/app-shell`'s published face — each named right.**
- Entry export: `MarketplaceInstalledPage` leaves `src/index.ts` (`:279` on main). `package.json` `exports` carries only `.` and `./styles.css`, so that barrel line was the page's entire published door. A grep of the four retired names across objectui main finds every hit inside the PR's file list, the CHANGELOGs, `.changeset/12675-packages-source.md` or the two ledger lines judged in ③, so no importer remains for the running Type Check to break on.
- `sideEffects`: both `InstalledListWidget` entries (dist and src) go with the barrel's bare `import './console/marketplace/InstalledListWidget.js'`; the other registering modules are untouched. `check:sdui-registration-pins` (in Repo Gates, success) reads that array against the built console.
- Registered component types: the deleted file held the one `ComponentRegistry.register('marketplace:installed-list', …, { namespace: 'app-shell' })`, so exactly `marketplace:installed-list` and its twin `app-shell:marketplace:installed-list` leave the registry. `known-schema-types.ts` loses exactly those two lines, which is what `scripts/regenerate-known-schema-types.mjs` derives from source registration calls (`--check` runs in Repo Gates).
- Routes: both `system/marketplace/installed` routes (no-active-app block `:1111`, app block `:1261`), the lazy declaration (`:91`) and the `APP_ROUTE_METADATA_READS` row leave together; `appRouteMetadataReads-12809.test.ts` pins table == routes both ways. The path now falls to `system/marketplace/:packageId`; the changeset states it and gives the fix, and the card rules no staged window. Right.

**B. What leaves `@object-ui/cli`'s face — right.** `KNOWN_SCHEMA_TYPES` narrows by the two keys, so `objectui check` now reports `type: 'marketplace:installed-list'` as unknown — the correct answer for a type nothing in the ObjectUI stack registers (the generator's own header: the check's claim is "names a component the ObjectUI stack registers"). `NAMESPACED_REFUSED_AT_TYPE` 306 → 304 is the direction the ratchet's own failure text demands ("LOWER … in this same change"); both keys were namespaced and not `field:`. A flip with its subjects gone, not a weakening.

**C. Nothing still served or authored reaches the removed names — right.**
- objectstack `d3d0644`: `packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-ui.ts` — `MARKETPLACE_INSTALLED_UI_BUNDLE` has no `pages` key; its one entry `nav_marketplace_installed` is `type: 'component'`, `componentRef: 'developer:packages'`, `params: { source: 'marketplace' }`. `marketplace-installed-ui-entry.pin.test.ts` pins `servedPageNames` not containing `marketplace_installed` and the bundle carrying no `pages`. `system/marketplace/installed`: zero hits outside CHANGELOGs. `marketplace:installed-list` survives only in the spec (`component.zod.ts:8320` row, `page.zod.ts:1333`, a vocabulary comment), spec tests, lint tests (`validate-component-types.test.ts:117`, `validate-component-props.test.ts`), a `platform-page-i18n-parity` SAMPLE_PAGE fixture and one test comment — no served page, no example, no docs page. The `nav_marketplace_installed` label translations stay, correctly: the nav entry lives on. objectstack's `.objectui-sha` is `5e15928b46`; the triage ordering note for the cloud seat (its `.objectui-sha` must not pass this merge before its `.objectstack-sha` carries #23933) stands unchanged.
- objectui `8523e81db`: outside the PR's files the names appear only in `.changeset/12675-packages-source.md` (prose; pending release text that reads as accurate history — redirect first, then retirement), three CHANGELOGs (release-owned, ruled off-limits) and the two `registry-inputs-spec-parity.test.ts` lines judged in ③. No README, `docs/`, `examples/` or `apps/site` hit, so `check:readme-exports` and `check:docs-route-closure` had nothing to move.

**D. The "Installed (N)" button's new target is the URL the retired redirect produced — right, both branches.** `MarketplacePage.tsx:213,221` on main: `const { appName } = useParams(); const basePath = appName ? '/apps/' + appName : ''`. New: `packagesHref(basePath || '/apps/setup', 'marketplace')`; `packagesHref` (`packageSource.ts`) is `base + '/component/developer/packages?source=marketplace'`. The retired `InstalledList`: `basePath = appName ? '/apps/' + appName : '/apps/setup'`, then `Navigate to={packagesHref(basePath, 'marketplace')} replace`. The old button pushed `basePath + '/system/marketplace/installed'`, a route in the same block as the page, so the redirect's `appName` was the page's own. Result: `/apps/APP/component/developer/packages?source=marketplace` with an app, `/apps/setup/component/developer/packages?source=marketplace` without — the same URL, and the same single resulting history entry (push then replace before, one push now). Pinned by (e) flipped and (f) added in `MarketplacePage.loadingStates-12710.test.tsx`; the dev's one ablation went red on exactly those two. The new `packagesHref` import is the edge the deleted widget already carried, now taken by a page that is itself `lazy()`, so no new eager edge; Bundle Analysis and Build & E2E are green.

**E. No pin was weakened.** Every deleted assertion's subject is deleted with it: the widget registration and the legacy route (the `PackagesPage.source-12675.test.tsx` describe, its header bullet and now-unused imports), the `/apps/ghost/system/marketplace/installed` row (`pseudoRouteSegments`; the `acme.crm` row still covers the `:packageId` sibling), the four `vi.mock`s of the deleted module, and the lazy page's `toContain`. `vite-declared-lazy-views.test.ts` 12 → 11 is exact: on main AppContent declares 8 single-file views, the metadata-admin barrel and 3 marketplace pages through relative specifiers (the parser skips the bare `@object-ui/plugin-designer`). `check-installed-spec-pin-claims.test.ts` REFUSAL 1 is re-pointed, not dropped: the rewritten ledger line still holds `New in`, `17.3.0` and now `installedAppsPins`; its only `installed` sits inside that identifier (followed by a word character), so the word-bounded `/\binstalled\b/i` marker stays silent and no other `CLAIM_MARKERS` entry matches, while the FIRING CONTROL's `New in` → `the pin is` still lights `pin-is`. `lineContaining` needs exactly one line with all three fragments; neither the key line nor the `:4567` census comment carries `installedAppsPins`. The cited `MarketplaceRowActions.installedAppsPins.test.tsx` exists on main; the `.mjs` header follows the same rename.

No budget or ceiling touched.

### ② Semver level

- PR body line 2 reads `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, and the changeset carries the same line. Changeset Declaration, Bump Policy, Fixed Group Check, Claim Re-read and Overwrite Report are all success.
- `.changeset/12733-retire-installed-apps-view.md`: `@object-ui/app-shell: minor`, `@object-ui/cli: minor`, never `major` — right under the fixed-group rule (`.changeset/config.json` holds both in the one `fixed` group; `check-changeset-no-major.mjs`: objectui's major is `@objectstack`'s, so a breaking change here ships as `minor` with the break spelled out). The body states the break ("breaking for a host that used one of the retired names") and FROM → TO for each retired name: the export (exported and redirecting → no export, import fails to compile), the widget and its `app-shell:` twin (registered → not registered; unknown-component panel; `objectui check` no longer knows it), the two routes (redirecting → none; the path falls to `:packageId`), the button (direct URL), plus the `sideEffects` departure and the one-line fix. That matches what the diff publishes, including the `known-schema-types.ts` narrowing the cli line names.
- `@object-ui/console` (`apps/console/vite.config.ts` and tests) sits in the same fixed group and rides the same `minor`; the Changeset Declaration gate accepted the one changeset, and the vite change publishes no behaviour.

### ③ Boundary flags

Dev report `6243019442`: six deviations, one open question, three out-of-scope findings — each answered.

Deviations: (1) the cli ratchet test outside the claim's surface — accepted, a reader of the regenerated file whose own text demands the move; declared in the PR body. (2) `ApiConsolePage.requestPreset-10591.test.tsx` — accepted, one of "the tests that name them", only the mock went. (3) done-when part 1 residuals — (a) judged under the open question below; (b) `.changeset/12675-packages-source.md` — accepted: a prose face and pending release text that is accurate history once both release; `check-installed-spec-pin-claims.mjs`'s `SCAN_EXCLUSIONS` does exclude `.changeset/` as "dated the same way" as CHANGELOGs, as the dev said. (4) base cut from `bc281f4a1` and re-measured; main is now `8523e81db`, the PR's base sha, with no overlap — accepted. (5) commit trailers per AGENTS.md — reported only, not a contract matter. (6) comments rewritten with figures and dates kept — accepted, verified in both hunks.

Open question — may `UNJUDGED_SPEC_BLOCKS['marketplace:installed-list']` stay while the installed `@objectstack/spec` still declares the row? **Answer A: it stays, and this is not a done-when breach this PR can close.** Evidence from the cited code:
